how_it_works.1_process_visible: Every brushstroke is a git commit. Every generation is logged to ntfy.sh/primals-membrane-notes. Subscribe and watch.
how_it_works.2_result_emergent: The painting starts at alpha 0.03 — nearly invisible. Trust accumulates layer by layer. No shortcuts.
how_it_works.3_chain_intact: Each painting hashes into the next via sourdough chain (blake2b). Break the chain → break the flavor.
how_it_works.4_fossils_honest: Dead code moves to /js/fossil/, not deleted. The organism keeps its failed experiments. Read: /js/fossil/
how_it_works.5_mutual_painting: Visitors paint us via beacons. We paint outward. Both visible. Klein inversion.

current_state.note: Alpha 0.03 → trust is in early accumulation. Come back. Watch the painting emerge.

not_zk: ZK proves knowledge without revealing it. We prove character by revealing process.
not_positive_trust: Positive trust exposes everything. We expose the brushstrokes, not the painting.
painting_trust: Watch the hand move. See the layers build. Trust the painter because you saw every stroke. The painting is never 100% opaque — there's always another layer being painted. The remainder is alive.
